exactSourceSemantics.subject: nilou-a4
exactSourceSemantics.observation: a4Bonus is a zero-valued struct field until the first 30-frame update. Re-entering a4 does not reset its existing value; each periodic update reads MaxHP and replaces the stored value.
exactSourceSemantics.implementation: An initial zero creation receipt is registered only when no creation ID exists. Re-entry retains the last value and ID until the original update task replaces both.
